output.murderer: Dr Casimir Vauthier, the family physician
output.reasoning: Hall clock: it struck ten when the regulator (true at ten) showed 9:48, so the hall clock runs 12 minutes fast. It therefore struck "eleven" at true 10:48. Girard saw its face at 11:02 just after the strike, so he came in at true 10:50. His watch read 10:46 then, so it is 4 minutes slow. Check: he heard the piano start at 10:29 on his watch, which is true 10:33. Kitchen clock: it read 11:13 at the hall strike, so it is 25 minutes fast. Lina arrived at 10:47 on it, which is true 10:22. That matches her leaving the atelier at about 10:20, so she and Rosa alibi each other. The piano ran from 10:58 to 11:11 on the kitchen clock, which is true 10:33 to 10:46. That agrees with Girard's piano start. Odile was playing the whole time, so she is cleared. Félix's watch is 20 minutes slow, as at dinner. His 10:18 thump and repeater is true 10:38. Girard's faint bells at 10:34 on his watch, plus 4, is also true 10:38. Girard was in the street and Félix was in the library, and both heard the repeater. The regulator reading 10:05 is a fake, because Lina saw it running at 10:20. Vauthier is the only one with the time and opportunity. He left the salon at true 10:33 and came back at 10:46, a 13-minute gap. He claimed to leave at 10:45 on his watch, which was 2 fast at nine, so his watch must have been set ahead to hide the gap. That is the murderer's adjustment and a lie. The blow fell at 22:38.
